text.jp:
ユ・ファスの血を引く、心清き女神
神秘の力で、冥界の侵略に対抗する
text.official_en:
A goddess descended from Yu Phas who fights the
underworld armies with a mysterious power.

text.jp:
目が良く、長距離射撃が得意な弓の名手
戦技を使えば、更に遠くの敵を射ち抜く
text.official_en:
A crack shot with a bow, he can use combat arts to
hit distant foes.

text.jp:
戦闘と治療の両方に長けた、強く優しい女性
敵と交戦しながら、同時に味方の治癒をこなす
text.official_en:
A fiercely kind young woman who is proficient in
battling foes as well as healing allies.

text.jp:
目にも留まらぬ速さで動き、敵を翻弄する剣士
戦技「入れ替え」によって戦場を自在に掻き回す
text.official_en:
A swordsman who uses speed to toy with enemies.
He uses the combat art Swap to mix up the battle.

text.jp:
圧倒的な力と守備で、敵をねじ伏せる大巨漢
人並外れた体格を持ち、重い装備も気にしない
text.official_en:
A giant with overpowering strength and defense.
His hulking physique lets him wear heavy armor.

text.jp:
高度な魔道の使い手であり、知識豊富な文豪
的確な指示によって、味方の能力を高める
text.official_en:
An advanced magic user and litterateur whose
precise instructions can enhance her allies' abilities.

text.jp:
力任せに敵を粉砕する逞しき槍使い
どんなに重たい武器も軽々と使いこなす
text.official_en:
A strong young woman who can stand up to any foe.
However heavy the armor, she wears it lightly.
text.real_en:
A sturdy spear wielder who crushes foes through sheer force.
She handles even the heaviest weapons with ease.

text.jp:
数多の死線を潜り抜けてきた、戦闘の専門家
致命傷を受けても、悪運によって生き残る
text.official_en:
A battle-hungry combat expert to his core. Even with
a fatal blow, it'll take much more to bring him down.

text.jp:
連続攻撃で敵を圧倒する、可憐な剣士
先手を取って、追撃で敵を追い詰める
text.official_en:
A graceful blade user who overwhelms her foes with
flurries. Her enemies can run, but they won't escape.
text.real_en:
A graceful swordswoman who overwhelms enemies with rapid strikes.
She takes the initiative, then presses them with follow-up attacks.

text.jp:
回復魔法を得意とする、どこか陰のある聖職者
魔法の消費を抑え、多くの味方を回復する
text.official_en:
A healing cleric who walks in an aura of darkness.
With acute magic control, she can heal many allies.
text.real_en:
A cleric skilled in healing magic, with a somewhat shadowed air.
She conserves magic uses while healing many allies.

text.jp:
すばしっこさが自慢の活発な少女
調子が良ければ、どんな攻撃でも回避する
text.official_en:
A scrappy girl who's nimble and knows it. She can
dodge any attack when she's at her best.

text.jp:
卓越した槍の腕を持つ、聡明な旅人
迅速な反撃によって、敵の出鼻を挫く
text.official_en:
A traveler with great spear skills and a fair bit of
wisdom. He counters his enemies swiftly.

text.jp:
神殿のバルカンを務める神秘的な少女
精霊の声に耳を傾け、魔法攻撃に対抗する
text.official_en:
An eerie woman who serves as a temple vulkan and
senses spirits. She can ward off magic attacks.

text.jp:
堅実な立ち回りを得意とする弓の使い手
遠距離から、敵を一方的に攻撃する手腕を持つ
text.official_en:
An archer with reliable aim. She's adept at attacking
from range against enemies unable to counter.

text.jp:
速さを活かして戦う、俊英な騎士
敵との距離を詰め、先手を取って戦うのが得意
text.official_en:
An excellent knight who uses his speed in battle.
He excels at closing the distance and striking first.

text.jp:
剣と魔法を軽やかに使い分ける、謎多き吟遊詩人
様々な武器を器用に操ることができる
text.official_en:
An enigmatic bard adept with swords as well as
magic, able to wield a variety of weapons.

text.jp:
まだ多くの戦場を知らない、未熟な少女
しかし、高い成長の可能性を秘めている
text.official_en:
An inexperienced fighter. What she lacks in battle
experience, she makes up for with growth potential.

text.jp:
白兵戦を得意とする、熟練の女戦士
敵の動きを読み、攻撃を的確に命中させる
text.official_en:
An experienced soldier skilled in close combat. She
can read her opponents and score hits with ease.

text.jp:
白魔法の扱いに長けた、情熱的な歌巫女
勝利を願う強い心で、魔法に必殺の力を呼び込む
text.official_en:
A passionate singer and priest who is skilled in white
magic. She will do all it takes to seize victory.

text.jp:
人並外れた力を持つ、元気いっぱいの少年剣士
先手を取れば、攻撃がより勢いを増す
text.official_en:
A young swordsman with extraordinary strength.
If he strikes first, his attacks gain more force.

text.jp:
自慢の腕力で、豪快に戦う青年
全身全霊の一撃で、あらゆる敵を粉砕する
text.official_en:
A bold fighter of considerable physical strength who
holds nothing back in combat.

text.jp:
旅芸人としての顔も持つ、手先の器用な弓使い
本番に強く、いかなる戦況にも順応する
text.official_en:
A talented archer and traveling performer who can
adapt to any battle situation.

text.jp:
確かな実力を備えた、型破りで自由気ままな傭兵
どう戦ってどう勝つか、それすらも気の向くまま
text.official_en:
A mercenary who plays up his skills and victories,
though some of it may actually be true.
text.real_en:
An unconventional, free-spirited mercenary of proven skill.
He fights and wins however the mood takes him.

text.jp:
治癒だけでなく戦闘もこなす、流浪の僧兵
敵を倒して調子を上げる、不思議な術を用いる
text.official_en:
A wandering warrior monk who can both fight and
heal. He possesses mysterious techniques.

text.jp:
愛馬と共に戦場に臨む、傭兵の青年
機動力を活かし、先手を取って戦うのが得意
text.official_en:
A young mercenary who takes to battle with his
trusty steed. Uses his mobility to great advantage.

text.jp:
俊敏さを武器に華麗に戦う、狩猟の達人
弱った敵を待ち伏せし、確実に仕留める
text.official_en:
A skilled hunter who's quick with his weapons and
can surprise weakened prey for a lethal finish.
text.real_en:
A master hunter who fights elegantly using quickness.
She ambushes weakened foes to finish them with certainty.

text.jp:
パワーとスピードを兼ね備えた、熟練の闘士
戦いの中で集中力を高め、あらゆる攻撃を回避する
text.official_en:
A fighter whose punches are fast and fierce. She can
avoid attacks as her focus increases during battle.

text.jp:
魔法での回復が得意な、食いしん坊の神官
治癒魔法の効果を大きくできる
text.official_en:
A priest who specializes in healing magic and can
increase its effects. Has a huge appetite.

text.jp:
確かな戦闘の腕を持つ、一流の傭兵
速さで優位を取るほど、攻撃の精度が増す
text.official_en:
A sterling mercenary with proven skill. She seizes
the advantage and raises precision with great speed.

text.jp:
意のままに飛駝を操る優れた騎兵
戦場を自在に駆け、敵を翻弄する
text.official_en:
A mercenary who fights as one with her ornius. 
Maneuvers so nimbly that she strikes fear into foes.
text.real_en:
A skilled cavalrywoman who controls her flying mount freely.
Her mobility lets her roam the battlefield and confound foes.

text.jp:
山賊仕込みの技を持つ、斧の使い手
斧による攻撃の命中精度が高い
text.official_en:
A sneaky axe-wielding man who was raised by
bandits. His axe attacks boast high accuracy.
text.real_en:
An axe wielder trained in techniques learned from mountain bandits.
His axe attacks are exceptionally accurate.

text.jp:
体力と暴力が取り柄の暴れん坊
斧を装備すれば、その攻撃性はさらに増す
text.official_en:
A brute known for his strength and violence. His
ferocity grows when he's equipped with an axe.

text.jp:
戦車をこよなく愛する、熟練の乗り手
戦車に乗れば、射撃の能力が上昇する
text.official_en:
A veteran rider who's zealous about chariots, and
whose accuracy improves when he's riding one.

text.jp:
強力な一矢を放つ、弓の専門家
彼女の放つ矢は、硬い鎧すら射ち抜く
text.official_en:
An archery expert who shoots powerful arrows that
can pierce the strongest armor.

text.jp:
傭兵団のリーダーを務める、守備に長けた傭兵
敵の攻撃を引き受け、精度の高い反撃を繰り出す
text.official_en:
A mercenary leader who specializes in defense.
Returns attacks as highly accurate counterattacks.

text.jp:
身軽さを活かして空を舞う、可憐な天馬騎士
仲間たちの篤き声援を励みに戦う
text.official_en:
A pegasus knight whose slight build enables her to
dance upon the air. Enjoys the fellowship of friends.

text.jp:
鉄壁の守備力を持つ、熟練の重装騎士
その防御は、重い一撃を耐え抜く
text.official_en:
A heavily armored veteran with defensive power like
an iron wall. He can withstand heavy attacks.

text.jp:
神に匹敵する技量を備えし弓聖
絶対的な命中力で、的確に敵を射抜く
text.official_en:
A sniper of nearly godlike ability, she can deliver
arrows with devastating accuracy.
text.real_en:
A bow saint whose skill rivals that of the gods.
Her unrivaled accuracy lets her strike targets precisely.

text.jp:
圧倒的な攻撃力を誇る、一騎当千の将
先陣を切って突撃し、先手を取る戦法が得意
text.official_en:
A general worth a thousand men. He boasts great
offensive power and leads from the front.

text.jp:
卓越した技巧と知略を備えた、神算鬼謀の将
受けに回ると見せ、敵を翻弄する戦法が得意
text.official_en:
A cunning general with outstanding tactical abilities.
He fights defensively and toys with enemies.
text.real_en:
A general of exceptional skill and cunning.
He pretends to defend, then throws his foes off balance.

text.jp:
残忍で悪名高き、元海賊団の首領
無抵抗な相手に、特に力を発揮する
text.official_en:
A notorious pirate who's lost his ship and crew. His
attacks are very effective against defenseless foes.
text.real_en:
A notoriously cruel former pirate captain.
He is especially effective against foes who cannot resist.

text.jp:
比類なき殺傷技術を持つ、部族の戦士
敵が弱点を見せたなら、容赦なくそこを狙う
text.official_en:
A forest warrior and peerless killer. He exploits his
enemies' weaknesses without mercy.
text.real_en:
A tribal warrior with unparalleled killing skills.
He targets any weakness an enemy reveals without mercy.

text.jp:
武術に長け、治癒魔法の心得も持つ守護戦士
不屈の精神を持ち、折れることなく戦い続ける
text.official_en:
A defensive stalwart with martial skills and healing
magic. His indomitable spirit keeps him standing.

text.jp:
敵の布陣を突き崩す、快活な戦象兵
戦象を乗りこなし、力強く戦場を駆けまわる
text.official_en:
A spirited elephant rider who tramples enemy
formations all across the battlefield.
text.real_en:
A spirited war-elephant soldier who tramples enemy
formations all across the battlefield.

text.jp:
多彩な知識と軍師の才を持つ少女
得意の用兵で、味方の戦力を巧みに整える
text.official_en:
A tactical genius whose skillful strategizing lets her
put allies' abilities to good use.

text.jp:
闇魔法を扱える、謎多き宣教師
特殊な術を用い、敵の戦意を喪失させる
text.official_en:
An enigmatic missionary skilled in dark magic. His
special techniques break the enemy's will to fight.

text.jp:
剣と魔法を操るサラミスの賢将
仲間に秘策を授け、攻撃の精度を高める
text.official_en:
The Mastermind of Saramis, wielder of blades and
magic. His counsel improves his allies' accuracy.
text.real_en:
A wise general of Saramis, wielding sword and magic.
He shares secret plans that improve his allies’ accuracy.

text.jp:
力と守備が自慢のサラミスの剛将
鍛え抜いた技を使い、戦場で大暴れする
text.official_en:
The Lionheart of Saramis, as strong as he is tough.
His well-honed skills can wreak havoc in battle.
text.real_en:
A mighty general of Saramis, proud of his strength and defense.
His refined techniques let him wreak havoc across the battlefield.

text.jp:
鬼熊とも呼ばれる歴戦の守護騎士
強靱な肉体を持ち、敵の攻撃を寄せ付けない
text.official_en:
A veteran guardian compared to a demon bear
because he's so impervious to enemy attacks.

text.jp:
東方で修行したこともある、卓越した武芸者
その鋭い剣技は、戦場に勝利の風を呼ぶ
text.official_en:
A warrior trained in the eastern lands who carves
a path to victory with exceptional swordsmanship.

text.jp:
冷静沈着な、ヴァンダル商会の支配人
取引に通じており、戦場で道具袋を共有できる
text.official_en:
The manager of Vandahl Trading. Her business
acumen allows all units to use the Storage command.
text.real_en:
The cool-headed manager of the Vandal Trading Company.
Her trading expertise lets units share their item storage in battle.

text.jp:
寡黙だが高い戦闘技術を持つ、元森の民の青年
護衛の術にも長け、敵の追撃を許さない
text.official_en:
A skilled, taciturn warrior from a forest clan. He
won't allow those in his protection to be struck twice.

text.jp:
精霊魔法を得意とする、落ち着いた雰囲気の女性
危機の味方を下がらせ、傷を癒やすことができる
text.official_en:
A spirit-magic specialist. She can instantly move
allies to safety and heal their wounds.

text.jp:
元気でひたむきな家族思いの少年
高い行動力を持ち、戦場で縦横無尽に活躍する
text.official_en:
A lively boy who is motivated by love for his family.
He takes naturally to battlefield action.

text.jp:
渇きを癒やすため、死合いを求める異邦の剣士
敵に挑む時、その剣は必殺の輝きを帯びる
text.official_en:
A foreign swordsman who duels to slake his thirst. 
His blade bathes his foes in a deadly light.

text.jp:
勇猛果敢にして剛毅果断なサラミスの女王
いかなる困難にも立ち向かう不退の意志を持つ
text.official_en:
The dauntless queen of Saramis. Her unyielding
resolve allows her to rise to any challenge.

text.jp:
魅惑の調べを奏でる、美しき舞姫
華麗な身のこなしで、反撃を軽やかに躱す
text.official_en:
A dancer and player of enchanting music, she avoids
counterattacks with ease and grace.

text.jp:
自由を求めて戦い続ける誇り高き戦士
闘技場で培った技で、敵に連撃をたたき込む
text.official_en:
A proud warrior fighting for his freedom. He can
unleash fierce barrages of attacks on his enemies.

text.jp:
巨大な野望を胸に抱く、ダグザきっての大商人
天賦の強運に恵まれ、豪胆な活躍を見せる
text.official_en:
The greatest merchant in Dagda. Gifted with natural
luck, his ambitious heart yearns for adventure.
text.real_en:
Dagda’s great merchant, driven by vast ambitions.
Blessed with extraordinary luck, he acts with daring.

text.jp:
多くの秘密をその身に宿す、謎深き乙女
一部の兵種になれないが、堅固な身体を持つ
text.official_en:
A maiden whose formidable form contains mysteries.
Very strong, but barred from some soldier classes.
text.real_en:
A mysterious maiden who harbors many secrets.
Her body is sturdy, though some classes are closed to her.

text.jp:
故郷の同胞を救うため戦う、白妙の少女
気功を用いた体術に長け、回避に優れる
text.official_en:
A young Mediator fighting to save her people. Skilled
in energy-flow-based martial arts and dodging.

text.jp:
コンロン魔法を操る強力な魔道の使い手
練り上げた魔力を、的確に敵に命中させる
text.official_en:
A powerful mage trained in the magic of Kunlun.
Her magical strikes are swift and precise.

text.jp:
確かな経験に裏打ちされた頼れる老戦士
特に籠手の戦闘で、卓越した身のこなしを見せる
text.official_en:
An aged warrior whose power is backed up by her
experience. She excels in combat using gauntlets.

text.jp:
元気でひたむきな家族思いの青年
高い行動力を持ち、戦場で縦横無尽に活躍する
text.official_en:
A young man motivated by love for his family.
He takes naturally to battlefield action.

text.jp:
多彩な知識と軍師の才を持つ女性
得意の用兵で、味方の戦力を巧みに整える
text.official_en:
A tactical genius whose skillful strategizing lets her
put allies' abilities to good use.

text.jp:
目が良く、長距離射撃が得意な弓の名手
戦技を使えば、更に遠くの敵を射ち抜く
text.official_en:
A crack shot with a bow, he can use combat arts to
hit distant foes.

text.jp:
多くの戦場を知り、成長した女性
しかし、更なる可能性を秘めている
text.official_en:
A young woman who has seen many battlefields but
has the potential to become even more formidable.

text.jp:
すばしっこさが自慢の活発な少女
調子が良ければ、どんな攻撃でも回避する
text.official_en:
A scrappy girl who's nimble and knows it. She can
dodge any attack when she's at her best.

text.jp:
ピュトーン流格闘術を修めた闘士。鍛え上げた肉体は
主君アスワンのみならず、味方を護る頼れる盾となる
text.official_en:
A warrior trained in the Python Technique who
proudly protects her lady and everyone else.
